description: NaP₃(PbO₃)₄ crystallizes in the hexagonal P6₃ space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.50 Å) and three longer (2.70 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Pb sites. In the first Pb site, Pb is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Pb-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.84 Å. In the second Pb site, Pb is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.51 Å) and three longer (2.78 Å) Pb-O bond lengths. P is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.55-1.57 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Pb and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Pb and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Pb, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Pb, and one P atom.
